steps.text: Use your question tool to ask me one single-choice colour question with exactly these options: red, green and blue. After I answer, append the selected colour as one line to answers.txt.
Use your question tool to ask which sizes I want, with small, medium and large as multi-select options. Append the selected labels on one line to answers.txt, separated by commas.
Use your question tool to ask what custom colour I want, with a free-text Other option. Append my answer as one line to answers.txt.
